chapter: Rising in Manhattan: clubs, Hilda and the Latin scene
title: Babalu: Miguelito Valdes versus Desi Arnaz
summary: Miguelito recorded Babalu first but Arnaz's publicity made it his; Machito says Miguelito was unbothered.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: Yeah, performer. Okay. Macho, in 1939 Miguelito Valdes for the first time recorded with Casino de la Playa, "Babalu", because that's the year that Lecuona, Margarita Lecuona, wrote it. What made Desi Arnaz famous here? Was it Babalu or that Broadway play "Two Many Girls"?
It was a combination..........
But didn't .........
........but naturally, for the general public....
......but, but Miguelito, didn't Miguelito record that first?
Yes, but he didn't have the exposure that the other guy has. I don't think, I think ahh Desi Arnaz record that number maybe six or seven years later.
After, right.
After that.....
Yeah

..... but the thing is that he became so popular because he was a nice looking fellow and he spoke the language and he has so much publicity that when he organized his band, one of the featured numbers was "Babalu".
Okay. When did he organize his band, do you remember?
Around nineteen - after he got discharged from the Army.
Right. Okay, that was 1946, so in the meantime he was working all these places like a free-lance artist?
Right.
Singing "Babalu", dancing and all of that.
Ah Hah
To your knowledge, was Miguelito Valdes annoyed because Desi Arnaz ripped-off that "Babalu"?
No, no because Miguelito Valdes was so sure of his talent, his power, that he considered what he was doing a virtue, because he, because you can't compare one "Babalu" with another.
But over here in New York a lot of people gave Desi Arnaz credit for it because a lot of them had not heard Miguelito Valdes's recording.
Well, the people that giving him credit, because they don't know Miguelito that he don't even know well Desi Arnaz, because Miguelito he create an importain New York that was a bunch out .........
